Required runtime:
- ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 or compatible
- Alchemy Objects v0.8
- ooRexx Crypto v0.1 (transitive Alchemy requirement)

Integration validation:
- Legal Effect v0.14

No runtime LLM dependency.
No mandatory cryptographic signature dependency for policy approval; approval evidence verification is host-pluggable.

Deployment topology, progressive version routing, and rollout acceptance gates are deterministic and have no runtime LLM or network dependency. Rollout observations are supplied by the host as evidence; v0.8 records exactly what was evaluated but does not itself prove a metric producer truthful.

Post-promotion rollback observations are host-supplied governance evidence. Automatic eligibility is deterministic; metric truth/provenance verification remains host-pluggable.
